findings.defect: “Parricide” asserts that the Emperor killed a parent; 패륜아 does not specify that act.
findings.rationale: The source condemns his violation of familial duty without identifying a parent as his victim.
findings.replacement: a notorious unfilial wretch and butcher

findings.current: They were lining up a whole list of special extras before the basic beheading: cut off my balls before tearing my limbs apart on the wheel, then slowly torture me until I was broken.
findings.defect: The draft puts torture after dismemberment and describes quartering as being done “on the wheel.”
findings.rationale: The source places castration and slow torture before the proposed quartering; it does not mention a wheel.
findings.replacement: Beheading was the basic option, and they kept piling on extras: cut off my balls, torture me slowly, then tear me limb from limb by quartering.
findings.source: 목을 치는 건 기본이고, 거열형으로 사지를 찢기 전에 불알을 자른 다음 천천히 고문으로 조지자는 특별 옵션까지 줄줄이 추가되고 있었으니까.

findings.current: What the hell is this lunatic doing all of a sudden?
findings.defect: The draft softens both the insult and the coarse description of the Emperor’s behavior.
findings.rationale: 미친 새끼 and 지랄 make Taekyung’s private reaction markedly cruder than the current wording.
findings.replacement: Why the fuck is this crazy bastard pulling this shit out of nowhere?
findings.source: 이 미친 새끼가 왜 갑자기 지랄이지

findings.current: It’s not as if such influence would be tolerated for martial artists who defy the Great Nation’s solemn laws—but it seems they rule as de facto overlords across Shanxi Province.
findings.defect: “Would be tolerated” turns the official’s judgment that such power is improper into a claim about whether authorities permit it.
findings.rationale: 가당치도 않은 이야기 expresses the speaker’s disapproval, while the following clause acknowledges the family’s actual dominance.
findings.replacement: Martial artists who defy the Great Nation’s solemn laws have no business wielding that kind of power… but apparently they rule as de facto overlords across Shanxi Province.
findings.source: 대국의 지엄한 국법을 거스르는 강호인들에게는 가당치도 않은 이야기지만…… 산서성 일대에서는 사실상 패자(霸者)로 군림하는 모양이더군.

summary: The draft adds a specific crime, changes the order of a threatened punishment, and softens one of Taekyung’s profane reactions.
